subject: data.open
name: National open data portal
what_would_settle_it: A government open-data portal or published open-data policy, or an official statement that none exists. The EITI reporting process is the only open-data commitment on the record.

subject: dpi.registry
name: National addressing
what_would_settle_it: A national addressing decree, a street-naming and numbering programme, or a postcode scheme filed with the postal union.

subject: include.access
name: Refugee legal framework
what_would_settle_it: A domestic refugee status determination law, an asylum procedure decree, or a registration and documentation instrument for refugees and asylum seekers.

subject: include.access
name: Disability rights framework
what_would_settle_it: A disability rights statute, an accessibility regulation, or a digital accessibility standard for public services.

subject: geopol.usa
name: United States digital engagement
what_would_settle_it: A bilateral investment treaty, a development finance project, or a memorandum with a United States cloud or platform company.

subject: geopol.eu
name: European Union digital cooperation
what_would_settle_it: A Global Gateway commitment, a country programme allocation, or a financing agreement naming Equatorial Guinea.

subject: finance.sustain
name: FY2025 enacted budget, digital investment lines
what_would_settle_it: The Ley de Presupuestos Generales del Estado 2025 volume with its Programa de Inversiones Públicas, read into the budget extract; FY2025 is held only from the comparator columns of the 2026 law.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Rule on where state data is hosted
what_would_settle_it: A decree, government cloud policy or implementing regulation of Ley 1/2016 fixing where state data is held and under whose law.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Hosting and supplier of the national identity database
what_would_settle_it: A CNEDOGE, interior ministry or supplier statement naming where the identity and passport database is hosted and who built and maintains it.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data jurisdiction, portability and exit terms of the Huawei and BCN agreements
what_would_settle_it: Publication of the December 2025 Huawei e-government memorandum or the February 2026 Backbone Connectivity Network agreement text.
